responsibility: This generator scans machine-description patterns to derive structural configuration limits and capability macros for insn-config.h. By walking insn, expand, split, peephole, and peephole2 RTL it computes maxima such as MAX_RECOG_OPERANDS, MAX_DUP_OPERANDS, MAX_INSNS_PER_SPLIT, and MAX_INSNS_PER_PEEP2, and it detects support for specific RTL features like conditional moves, conditional execution, lo_sum, rotate/rotatert, and peephole optimization forms, producing the compile-time configuration header consumed by recognizer and emitter code.
